value: Pebblebrook Studio has three offices: north, harbour and east.
The IT desk is open 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday.
Urgent outages outside desk hours go to the on-call technician through the support form.
Passwords are reset on the self-service account portal in about 5 minutes.
A locked account unlocks by itself after 15 minutes.
The desk answers a new ticket within 4 working hours.
The VPN gateway replacement was scheduled for the morning of 2026-11-07.
The harbour office's second printer, HB-PRN-2, has a paper feed fault.
The east office has no resident IT staff; a technician visits on Wednesdays.
Guest wifi networks are named Pebble-Guest followed by the office name; the code is on the reception card.
Spare laptops and headsets can be borrowed from the north office for up to two weeks.
The file share is backed up every night from 01:00 to 02:00.
A new starter's laptop is ready two working days after the manager opens a ticket.
Meeting rooms with video call kits: Granite, Slate, Tide, Jetty and Orchard.
The desk never asks for a password by chat, email or phone.
